architecturalBoundary: This artifact is an external observability/verification projection over runtime dependencies. MTS semantics must not depend on it; graph theory is not part of the MTS foundation.

objectSpecificShortcutDetector.note: Counts concrete multi-abit wire strings only when they directly participate in a binary control-flow expression or switch case. Structural data labels such as self-incidence 00/01/10/11 are not semantic shortcuts by themselves.

exactTheorySelectedAdmissionPath.note: This is the exact runtime path used by v0.13 selected-admission authority. SHA-256 Theory revision and portable proof replay APIs are outside this path.

stringAuthorityReadPath.note: The selected v0.13 source authority path reads accepted v0.12 STRING directly from Link poles and L/U identity. Neighboring producer/general codec APIs in the same module are outside this path.

capabilities.reason: The only ontological entity under analysis is Link; this projection does not introduce graph entities.

The v0.13 authority path uses readV012StringAnum as a read-only poles traversal over rooted byte chains. L/U and R identity determine byte bits/boundaries; general byte/quaternary parsing, materialization and serialization helpers are outside this selected path.
Dictionary scope/history/occurrence are Links; current visibility/history traversal and conflict checks are host execution.
Act header/field attachments are Links; current attachment enumeration/cardinality reading is host execution.
Role dictionary and template are Links; recursive role containment, replacement matching and visited-pair control are host algorithms.
Interpreter/DR/Rule/admission identities are Link-defined; replay sequencing and exact binding/cardinality checks are host execution.
Source slices, lexemes, Dictionary occurrences, Grammar/Theory membership and selected form sequences are Links; partition and structural replay checks are host execution.

Selected Theory/admission are Links. Current independent authority replays the external Theory artifact, compares canonical Link fingerprints and checks the selected admission against the exact admitted set.
Exact-Theory artifact replay allocates an isolated scratch Memory. Allocation is runtime/resource machinery; semantic meaning still comes from reconstructed Links.
EnumerableReadMemory.allLinks exposes the selected finite issued-Link support for canonical export. It is observability/representation support, not an ontological primitive.
Portable storage coordinates [start,end] are an external finite representation of Link topology, not MTS ontology.
Portable Theory artifact schema/coordinate validation is host envelope parsing and grants no proof authority by itself.
restoreTopology reconstructs canonical Links from external coordinates using the ordinary Memory write capabilities.
Allocation-independent canonical coordinates are computed by host ordering over already-existing Link topology; this is a representation/verification algorithm.
Theory identity, selected admissions and their pole-closure are Links; current finite support construction/filtering is host traversal.
Portable Theory replay reconstructs Links and re-exports canonical topology to reject noncanonical external representations.
Current exact-Theory equality compares canonical topology plus the selected Link coordinate through host JSON serialization.

metricMeaning.confirmedIndependentPrimitiveCount: Zero means no bootstrap capability has yet passed an elimination/irreducibility experiment; it does NOT mean the true minimal primitive count is zero.
metricMeaning.linkExecutedSemanticCapabilityCount: P1 counts a capability as Link-executed only if the execution mechanism itself is Link-defined. Link-grounded authority with host execution is counted as mixed, not self-hosted.
metricMeaning.hostLinkSemanticDuplicationCount: Deprecated compatibility name for the P1 candidate-overlap count; it does not prove semantic equivalence.
metricMeaning.directUndocumentedDependencyCount: Exact static count only for direct dependencies observed in the five candidate-kernel files.
metricMeaning.globalUndocumentedSemanticPathCount: Still UNMEASURED. P1f closes a conservative static candidate inventory, but only P1g runtime instrumentation/bypass falsification can establish observed path closure.
metricMeaning.objectSpecificHostSemanticShortcutCount: Counts exact multi-abit physical-term literals that directly participate in host control flow in the candidate kernel. It intentionally does not count structural self-incidence labels stored as data.
metricMeaning.coarseInheritedAuthorityAggregateCount: P1b requires the previous accepted-v0.12 authority aggregate to disappear in favor of explicit service-level capabilities.
metricMeaning.unresolvedNestedBootstrapBoundaryCount: P1c removes the last intentionally aggregated semantic-bootstrap boundary from the selected-admission authority chain.
metricMeaning.modelRevision: P1c changes measurement resolution; compare semantic capability identities, not raw counts, across P1/P1b/P1c.
metricMeaning.unresolvedRepresentationBoundaryCount: Zero means the currently selected v0.13 source/Rule authority chain has no intentionally aggregated representation boundary. This does not yet prove package-wide global trust closure.
metricMeaning.directSemanticWriteOwnerCount: P1e syntax-level count of distinct owners under ts/src that call the current write-method-name surface; P1f separately type-checks the observed owner set against Memory declarations.
metricMeaning.unclassifiedDirectSemanticWriteOwnerCoun: Zero means every P1e syntax-level owner is classified; P1f additionally verifies that the current observed owner set resolves to actual Memory write members.
metricMeaning.directSemanticWriteOwnersByCategory: Separates bootstrap realization, evidence/proof producers, representation, authorized target writes and tooling; category counts are not semantic primitive counts.
metricMeaning.packageWideObjectSpecificHostSemanticCou: Still UNMEASURED as a semantic-equivalence metric. P1f statically inventories candidate decision mechanisms; P1g runtime path coverage and later elimination decide which are actually object-specific semantic authority.
metricMeaning.hostLinkDuplicationCandidateCount: Semantic capabilities whose Link expression and host execution make them candidates for duplication analysis; candidate overlap is not confirmed equivalent duplication.
metricMeaning.confirmedHostLinkEquivalentDuplicationCo: UNMEASURED until equivalence/elimination experiments establish that a host mechanism duplicates Link-defined semantics rather than implementing a necessary external primitive.
metricMeaning.typedReadMemorySiteCount: S3 count of type-resolved property/call sites whose member declaration belongs to ReadMemory/Memory in ts/src/memory.ts.
metricMeaning.typedReadMemoryOwnerCount: S3 count of function/method owners containing at least one type-resolved ReadMemory access.
metricMeaning.staticSemanticDecisionCandidateOwnerCoun: S3 conservative static candidate count: owners with Link-dependent decisions, typed Memory-read decisions, literal/tag dispatch, fixed coordinate indexing, host callbacks or module-level mutable-state decisions. It is not a primitive count.
metricMeaning.staticDecisionOwnersByCategory: File-role classification of the S3 static candidate surface. Proof, representation, transport, resource and tooling categories must not be counted as foundation primitives.
metricMeaning.packageWideExactWireLiteralDispatchCount: S3 count signal for exact multi-abit wire-like literals participating in detected host equality dispatch. Zero does not by itself prove absence of all object-specific host semantics.

S0.meaning: Only candidate foundation/bootstrap semantic capabilities. Use this scope for minimal-foundation claims.

S1.meaning: Normative v0.13 public semantic paths plus their transitive dependencies.

S2.meaning: Retained accepted-v0.12 compatibility semantics used by the candidate.

S3.meaning: Whole ts/src implementation including proof, representation, transport, persistence, resource-control and tooling. P1e/P1f package-wide counts use S3 and are not a foundation-size denominator.

packageSemanticDecisionAudit.discovery: independent TypeScript Program/type-checker scan plus conservative host-decision signals; owner set is not derived from candidateKernelFiles or the dependency projection
limitations: Static candidate discovery is intentionally conservative and is not a semantic primitive count.
File-role classification separates semantic authority/proof replay/representation/transport/resource/tooling but does not prove semantic equivalence or independence.
Inter-procedural dataflow, dynamic aliasing, reflective/dynamic invocation and future write APIs require P1g runtime instrumentation/bypass falsification.
A zero exact-wire-literal signal does not imply zero object-specific host semantic authority.
